title: Postcode to National Grid Converter — OS Grid
description: Find a British National Grid reference for a representative postcode location when the provider supplies suitable grid coordinates.
summary_sentence: A postcode coordinate represents an area or group of addresses, not a verified property location.
quick_answer: postcodes.io supplies a representative postcode location and, where available, British National Grid eastings and northings. The workspace displays six- and ten-figure references; they do not establish an individual address or survey-level accuracy.

British forms ask for grid references, British life runs on postcodes. This page is the translation desk between them.
Attendees get postcodes for the satnav; the site file gets the grid reference for the record. Same place, both languages.
A postcode whose grid reference lands in the wrong county exposes the typo in the spreadsheet — geography as proofreader.

examples.label: Example · What a postcode point is

body.t: The conversion uses the postcode's representative point (from open postcode data) — a full UK postcode covers a small cluster of addresses, so its grid reference names the cluster's ground, not one doorstep.
Quote six figures (100 m) for a postcode's reference. Ten figures (1 m) would claim a survey the postcode never made — the ladder on this page is a honesty scale, not a quality dial.

faq: Where does the postcode's location come from?
Open postcode datasets (the postcodes.io family, built on ONS and Royal Mail-derived open data) publish a representative coordinate per postcode; the converter turns that point into a grid reference.
Rural postcodes cover huge areas — still one reference?
The postcode has a representative point, not a guarantee for every property. The result is not a surveyed address location.
They enter the data as Royal Mail creates them and the open datasets refresh. A brand-new estate's code may lag its first residents by a data cycle.
Current data answers with current codes; historic addresses may need their successor postcode first.
Northern Ireland uses a different grid. This tool does not produce British National Grid references for those postcodes; use an authoritative Irish grid converter.
Can I convert the reference back to the postcode?
Not uniquely — a grid square can straddle two postcodes. The NGR to Postcode Finder answers with the nearest postcode, labelled as such.
